vsm2.22:104.1: Idāni yāni tāni pariññādīni cattāri kiccāni vuttāni, tesu –
vsm2.22:104.2: Tividhā hoti pariññā, tathā pahānampi sacchikiriyāpi; Dve bhāvanā abhimatā, vinicchayo tattha ñātabbo.
vsm2.22:105.1: Tividhā hoti pariññāti ñātapariññā tīraṇapariññā pahānapariññāti evaṃ pariññā tividhā hoti.
vsm2.22:106.1: Tattha ‘‘abhiññāpaññā ñātaṭṭhena ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. mātikā 1.20) evaṃ uddisitvā
vsm2.22:106.2: ‘‘ye ye dhammā abhiññātā honti, te te dhammā ñātā hontī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.75) evaṃ saṅkhepato,
vsm2.22:106.3: ‘‘sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññeyyaṃ. Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ? Cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññeyya’’ntiādinā (paṭi. ma. 1.2) nayena vitthārato vuttā ñātapariññā nāma.
vsm2.22:107.1: ‘‘Pariññāpaññā tīraṇaṭṭhena ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. mātikā 1.21) evaṃ uddisitvā pana
vsm2.22:107.2: ‘‘ye ye dhammā pariññātā honti, te te dhammā tīritā hontī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.75) evaṃ saṅkhepato,
vsm2.22:107.3: ‘‘sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, pariññeyyaṃ. Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṃ pariññeyyaṃ? Cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, pariññeyya’’ntiādinā (paṭi. ma. 1.21) nayena vitthārato vuttā tīraṇapariññā nāma.
vsm2.22:107.4: Tassā kalāpasammasanato paṭṭhāya aniccaṃ dukkhamanattāti tīraṇavasena pavattamānāya yāva anulomā āveṇikā bhūmi.
vsm2.22:108.1: ‘‘Pahānapaññā pariccāgaṭṭhena ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. mātikā 1.22) evaṃ pana uddisitvā
vsm2.22:108.2: ‘‘ye ye dhammā pahīnā honti, te te dhammā pariccattā hontī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.75) evaṃ vitthārato vuttā
vsm2.22:108.4: Tassā bhaṅgānupassanato paṭṭhāya yāva maggañāṇā bhūmi, ayaṃ idha adhippetā.
vsm2.22:109.1: Yasmā vā ñātatīraṇapariññāyopi tadatthāyeva, yasmā ca ye dhamme pajahati, te niyamato ñātā ceva tīritā ca honti, tasmā pariññāttayampi iminā pariyāyena maggañāṇassa kiccanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.22:110.1: Tathā pahānampīti pahānampi hi vikkhambhanappahānaṃ tadaṅgappahānaṃ samucchedappahānanti pariññā viya tividhameva hoti.
vsm2.22:111.1: Tattha yaṃ sasevāle udake pakkhittena ghaṭena sevālassa viya tena tena lokiyasamādhinā nīvaraṇādīnaṃ paccanīkadhammānaṃ vikkhambhanaṃ, idaṃ vikkhambhanappahānaṃ nāma.
vsm2.22:111.2: Pāḷiyaṃ pana ‘‘vikkhambhanappahānañca nīvaraṇānaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvayato’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.24) nīvaraṇānaññeva vikkhambhanaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ pākaṭattā vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.22:111.3: Nīvaraṇāni hi jhānassa pubbabhāgepi pacchābhāgepi na sahasā cittaṃ ajjhottharanti, vitakkādayo appitakkhaṇeyeva.
vsm2.22:112.1: Yaṃ pana rattibhāge samujjalitena padīpena andhakārassa viya tena tena vipassanāya avayavabhūtena ñāṇaṅgena paṭipakkhavaseneva tassa tassa pahātabbadhammassa pahānaṃ, idaṃ tadaṅgappahānaṃ nāma.
vsm2.22:113.1: Yaṃ vā pana aṭṭhārasasu mahāvipassanāsu aniccānupassanāya niccasaññāya. Dukkhānupassanāya sukhasaññāya. Anattānupassanāya attasaññāya.
vsm2.22:113.2: Nibbidānupassanāya nandiyā. Virāgānupassanāya rāgassa. Nirodhānupassanāya samudayassa.
vsm2.22:113.3: Paṭinissaggānupassanāya ādānassa. Khayānupassanāya ghanasaññāya. Vayānupassanāya āyūhanassa.
vsm2.22:113.4: Vipariṇāmānupassanāya dhuvasaññāya. Animittānupassanāya nimittassa. Appaṇihitānupassanāya paṇidhiyā.
vsm2.22:113.5: Suññatānupassanāya abhinivesassa. Adhipaññādhammavipassanāya sārādānābhinivesassa. Yathābhūtañāṇadassanena sammohābhinivesassa.
vsm2.22:113.6: Ādīnavānupassanāya ālayābhinivesassa. Paṭisaṅkhānupassanāya appaṭisaṅkhāya. Vivaṭṭānupassanāya saṃyogābhinivesassa pahānaṃ.
vsm2.22:114.1: Tattha yathā aniccānupassanādīhi sattahi niccasaññādīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, taṃ bhaṅgānupassane vuttameva.
vsm2.22:114.2: Khayānupassanāti pana ghanavinibbhogaṃ katvā aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhenāti evaṃ khayaṃ passato ñāṇaṃ. Tena ghanasaññāya pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:115.2: Ārammaṇānvayena, ubho ekavavatthānā; Nirodhe adhimuttatā, vayalakkhaṇavipassanāti. –
vsm2.22:115.3: Evaṃ vuttā paccakkhato ceva anvayato ca saṅkhārānaṃ bhaṅgaṃ disvā tasmiññeva bhaṅgasaṅkhāte nirodhe adhimuttatā, tāya āyūhanassa pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:115.4: Yesaṃ hi atthāya āyūheyya, ‘‘te evaṃ vayadhammā’’ti vipassato āyūhane cittaṃ na namati.
vsm2.22:116.1: Vipariṇāmānupassanāti rūpasattakādivasena taṃ taṃ paricchedaṃ atikkamma aññathāpavattidassanaṃ.
vsm2.22:116.2: Uppannassa vā jarāya ceva maraṇena ca dvīhākārehi vipariṇāmadassanaṃ, tāya dhuvasaññāya pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:117.1: Animittānupassanāti aniccānupassanāva, tāya niccanimittassa pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:117.3: Suññatānupassanāti anattānupassanāva, tāya ‘‘atthi attā’’ti abhinivesassa pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:118.2: ‘‘Ārammaṇañca paṭisaṅkhā, bhaṅgañca anupassati; Suññato ca upaṭṭhānaṃ, adhipaññā vipassanā’’ti. –
vsm2.22:118.3: Evaṃ vuttā rūpādiārammaṇaṃ jānitvā tassa ca ārammaṇassa tadārammaṇassa ca cittassa bhaṅgaṃ disvā ‘‘saṅkhārāva bhijjanti, saṅkhārānaṃ maraṇaṃ, na añño koci atthī’’ti bhaṅgavasena suññataṃ gahetvā pavattā vipassanā.
vsm2.22:118.4: Sā adhipaññā ca dhammesu ca vipassanāti katvā adhipaññādhammavipassanāti vuccati, tāya niccasārābhāvassa ca attasārābhāvassa ca suṭṭhu diṭṭhattā sārādānābhinivesassa pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:119.1: Yathābhūtañāṇadassananti sappaccayanāmarūpapariggaho, tena ‘‘ahosiṃ nu kho ahaṃ atītamaddhāna’’ntiādivasena ceva, ‘‘issarato loko sambhotī’’tiādivasena ca pavattassa sammohābhinivesassa pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:120.1: Ādīnavānupassanāti bhayatupaṭṭhānavasena uppannaṃ sabbabhavādīsu ādīnavadassanañāṇaṃ, tena ‘‘kiñci allīyitabbaṃ na dissatī’’ti ālayābhinivesassa pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:120.2: Paṭisaṅkhānupassanāti muñcanassa upāyakaraṇaṃ paṭisaṅkhāñāṇaṃ, tena appaṭisaṅkhāya pahānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:121.2: Tadā hissa cittaṃ īsakapoṇe padumapalāse udakabindu viya sabbasmā saṅkhāragatā patilīyati, patikuṭati, pativattatīti vuttaṃ.
vsm2.22:121.3: Tasmā tāya saṃyogābhinivesassa pahānaṃ hoti, kāmasaṃyogādikassa kilesābhinivesassa kilesappavattiyā pahānaṃ hotīti attho.
vsm2.22:121.5: Pāḷiyaṃ pana ‘‘tadaṅgappahānañca diṭṭhigatānaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvayato’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.24) saṅkhepeneva vuttaṃ.
vsm2.22:122.1: Yaṃ pana asanivicakkābhihatassa rukkhassa viya ariyamaggañāṇena saṃyojanādīnaṃ dhammānaṃ yathā na puna pavatti, evaṃ pahānaṃ, idaṃ samucchedappahānaṃ nāma.
vsm2.22:122.2: Yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘samucchedappahānañca lokuttaraṃ khayagāmimaggaṃ bhāvayato’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.24).
vsm2.22:123.1: Iti imesu tīsu pahānesu samucchedappahānameva idha adhippetaṃ.
vsm2.22:123.2: Yasmā pana tassa yogino pubbabhāge vikkhambhanatadaṅgappahānānipi tadatthāneva, tasmā pahānattayampi iminā pariyāyena maggañāṇassa kiccanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.22:123.3: Paṭirājānaṃ vadhitvā rajjaṃ pattena hi yampi tato pubbe kataṃ, sabbaṃ ‘‘idañcidañca raññā kata’’ntiyeva vuccati.
vsm2.22:124.1: Sacchikiriyāpīti lokiyasacchikiriyā lokuttarasacchikiriyāti dvedhā bhinnāpi lokuttarāya dassanabhāvanāvasena bhedato tividhā hoti.
vsm2.22:125.1: Tattha ‘‘paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhīmhi, vasīmhi, paṭhamajjhānaṃ sacchikataṃ mayā’’tiādinā (pārā. 203-204) nayena āgatā paṭhamajjhānādīnaṃ phassanā lokiyasacchikiriyā nāma.
vsm2.22:125.2: Phassanāti adhigantvā ‘‘idaṃ mayā adhigata’’nti paccakkhato ñāṇaphassena phusanā.
vsm2.22:125.3: Imameva hi atthaṃ sandhāya ‘‘sacchikiriyā paññā phassanaṭṭhe ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. mātikā 1.24) uddisitvā ‘‘ye ye dhammā sacchikatā honti, te te dhammā phassitā hontī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.75) sacchikiriyaniddeso vutto.
vsm2.22:126.1: Apica attano santāne anuppādetvāpi ye dhammā kevalaṃ aparappaccayena ñāṇena ñātā, te sacchikatā honti.
vsm2.22:126.2: Teneva hi ‘‘sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, sacchikātabbaṃ. Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ? Cakkhu, bhikkhave, sacchikātabba’’ntiādi (paṭi. ma. 1.29) vuttaṃ.
vsm2.22:126.3: Aparampi vuttaṃ ‘‘rūpaṃ passanto sacchikaroti. Vedanaṃ…pe… viññāṇaṃ passanto sacchikaroti. Cakkhuṃ…pe… jarāmaraṇaṃ…pe… amatogadhaṃ nibbānaṃ passanto sacchikarotīti. Ye ye dhammā sacchikatā honti, te te dhammā phassitā hontī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.29).
vsm2.22:127.1: Paṭhamamaggakkhaṇe pana nibbānadassanaṃ dassanasacchikiriyā. Sesamaggakkhaṇesu bhāvanāsacchikiriyāti.
vsm2.22:127.2: Sā duvidhāpi idha adhippetā. Tasmā dassanabhāvanāvasena nibbānassa sacchikiriyā imassa ñāṇassa kiccanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.22:128.1: Dvebhāvanā abhimatāti bhāvanā pana lokiyabhāvanā lokuttarabhāvanāti dveyeva abhimatā.
vsm2.22:128.2: Tattha lokiyānaṃ sīlasamādhipaññānaṃ uppādanaṃ, tāhi ca santānavāsanaṃ lokiyabhāvanā.
vsm2.22:128.3: Lokuttarānaṃ uppādanaṃ, tāhi ca santānavāsanaṃ lokuttarabhāvanā.
vsm2.22:128.5: Lokuttarāni hi sīlādīni catubbidhampetaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppādeti. Tesaṃ sahajātapaccayāditāya tehi ca santānaṃ vāsetīti lokuttarabhāvanāvassa kiccanti.
vsm2.22:128.6: Evaṃ – Kiccāni pariññādīni, yāni vuttāni abhisamayakāle; Tāni ca yathāsabhāvena, jānitabbāni sabbānīti.
vsm2.22:129.1: Ettāvatā ca – ‘‘Sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañca bhāvaya’’nti. –
vsm2.22:129.2: Evaṃ sarūpeneva ābhatāya paññābhāvanāya vidhānadassanatthaṃ yaṃ vuttaṃ ‘‘mūlabhūtā dve visuddhiyo sampādetvā sarīrabhūtā pañca visuddhiyo sampādentena bhāvetabbā’’ti, taṃ vitthāritaṃ hoti.
vsm2.22:129.4: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Paññābhāvanādhikāre Ñāṇadassanavisuddhiniddeso nāma Bāvīsatimo paricchedo.
